facts.text: Published evidence supports using a portfolio of combination-selection methods because coverage has several incompatible meanings: coverage of discrete configurations, coverage of continuous parameter space, discovery of failures, and estimation of field rates. The evidence comes from NIST methodology and peer-reviewed automated-driving research, with most demonstrations on-road.
facts.quote: The published evidence supports a portfolio, because "coverage" has several incompatible meanings: coverage of discrete configurations, coverage of continuous parameter space, discovery of failures, and estimation of field rates.

facts.text: No single combination-selection method delivers all four forms of coverage: discrete configurations, continuous parameter space, failure discovery, and field-rate estimation. The supporting independent evidence consists of NIST methodology and peer-reviewed automated-driving research, with most demonstrations on-road.
facts.quote: No single method delivers all four.
